verses.original: δὲ Ἐν πεντεκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει τῆς ἡγεμονίας Τιβερίου Καίσαρος Ποντίου Πιλάτου ἡγεμονεύοντος τῆς Ἰουδαίας καὶ Ἡρῴδου τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Γαλιλαίας δὲ αὐτοῦ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ Φιλίππου τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς χώρας Ἰτουραίας καὶ Τραχωνίτιδος καὶ Λυσανίου τετρααρχοῦντος τῆς Ἀβιληνῆς
verses.transliteration: de En pentekaidekatō etei tēs hēgemonias Tiberiou Kaisaros Pontiou Pilatou hēgemoneuontos tēs Ioudaias kai Hērōdou tetraarchountos tēs Galilaias de autou tou adelphou Philippou tetraarchountos tēs chōras Itouraias kai Trachōnitidos kai Lysaniou tetraarchountos tēs Abilēnēs
verses.literal: - In [the] fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar [while] Pontius Pilate was governor - of Judea - Herod tetrarch - of Galilee - his - brother Philip tetrarch vvv vvv of Ituraea and Trachonitis and Lysanias tetrarch - of Abilene

verses.original: ἐπὶ ἀρχιερέως Ἅννα καὶ Καϊάφα ῥῆμα Θεοῦ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ Ἰωάννην τὸν υἱὸν Ζαχαρίου ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ
verses.transliteration: epi archiereōs Hanna kai Kaiapha rhēma Theou egeneto epi Iōannēn ton huion Zachariou en tē erēmō
verses.literal: during [the] high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas [the] word of God came to John - son of Zechariah in the wilderness

verses.original: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν περίχωρον τοῦ Ἰορδάνου κηρύσσων βάπτισμα μετανοίας εἰς ἄφεσιν ἁμαρτιῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai ēlthen eis pasan tēn perichōron tou Iordanou kēryssōn baptisma metanoias eis aphesin hamartiōn
verses.literal: - He went into all the region around the Jordan preaching a baptism of repentance for [the] forgiveness of sins

verses.original: ὡς γέγραπται ἐν βίβλῳ λόγων τοῦ Ἠσαΐου προφήτου Φωνὴ βοῶντος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ Ἑτοιμάσατε τὴν ὁδὸν Κυρίου ποιεῖτε εὐθείας τὰς τρίβους αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: hōs gegraptai en biblō logōn tou Ēsaiou prophētou Phōnē boōntos en tē erēmō Hetoimasate tēn hodon Kyriou poieite eutheias tas tribous autou
verses.literal: as it is written in [the] book of [the] words - of Isaiah [the] prophet [A] voice of one calling in the wilderness Prepare the way for [the] Lord make straight - paths for Him

verses.original: πᾶσα φάραγξ πληρωθήσεται καὶ πᾶν ὄρος καὶ βουνὸς ταπεινωθήσεται καὶ τὰ σκολιὰ ἔσται εἰς εὐθείαν καὶ αἱ τραχεῖαι ὁδοὺς εἰς λείας
verses.transliteration: pasa pharanx plērōthēsetai kai pan oros kai bounos tapeinōthēsetai kai ta skolia estai eis eutheian kai hai tracheiai hodous eis leias
verses.literal: Every valley shall be filled in and every mountain and hill made low - The crooked [ways] shall be made . . . straight and the rough ways - smooth

verses.original: καὶ πᾶσα σὰρξ ὄψεται τὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ σωτήριον
verses.transliteration: kai pasa sarx opsetai to tou Theou sōtērion
verses.literal: And all humanity will see - - God’s salvation

verses.original: οὖν Ἔλεγεν τοῖς ὄχλοις ἐκπορευομένοις βαπτισθῆναι ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ Γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν τίς ὑπέδειξεν ὑμῖν φυγεῖν ἀπὸ τῆς μελλούσης ὀργῆς
verses.transliteration: oun Elegen tois ochlois ekporeuomenois baptisthēnai hyp’ autou Gennēmata echidnōn tis hypedeixen hymin phygein apo tēs mellousēs orgēs
verses.literal: Then [John] said to the crowds coming out to be baptized by him You brood of vipers who warned you to flee from the coming wrath

verses.original: ποιήσατε καρποὺς οὖν ἀξίους τῆς μετανοίας καὶ μὴ ἄρξησθε λέγειν ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἔχομεν τὸν Ἀβραάμ Πατέρα γὰρ λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐκ τούτων τῶν λίθων ὁ Θεὸς δύναται ἐγεῖραι τέκνα τῷ Ἀβραάμ
verses.transliteration: poiēsate karpous oun axious tēs metanoias kai mē arxēsthe legein en heautois echomen ton Abraam Patera gar legō hymin hoti ek toutōn tōn lithōn ho Theos dynatai egeirai tekna tō Abraam
verses.literal: Produce fruit then in keeping with - repentance And {do} not begin to say to yourselves We have - Abraham [as our] father For I tell you that out of these - stones - God can raise up children - for Abraham

verses.original: ἡ ἀξίνη δὲ καὶ ἤδη κεῖται πρὸς τὴν ῥίζαν τῶν δένδρων οὖν πᾶν δένδρον μὴ ποιοῦν καλὸν καρπὸν ἐκκόπτεται καὶ βάλλεται εἰς πῦρ
verses.transliteration: hē axinē de kai ēdē keitai pros tēn rhizan tōn dendrōn oun pan dendron mē poioun kalon karpon ekkoptetai kai balletai eis pyr
verses.literal: The axe vvv vvv vvv lies ready at the root of the trees and every tree vvv that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into [the] fire

verses.original: οἱ ὄχλοι Καὶ ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες Τί οὖν ποιήσωμεν
verses.transliteration: hoi ochloi Kai epērōtōn auton legontes Ti oun poiēsōmen
verses.literal: The crowds - asked him - What then should we do

verses.original: δὲ Ἀποκριθεὶς ἔλεγεν αὐτοῖς Ὁ ἔχων δύο χιτῶνας μεταδότω τῷ ἔχοντι μὴ καὶ ὁ ἔχων βρώματα ποιείτω ὁμοίως
verses.transliteration: de Apokritheis elegen autois Ho echōn dyo chitōnas metadotō tō echonti mē kai ho echōn brōmata poieitō homoiōs
verses.literal: - [John] replied . . . . . . Whoever has two tunics should share with him who has none and whoever has food should do the same

verses.original: δὲ καὶ τελῶναι Ἦλθον βαπτισθῆναι Διδάσκαλε καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς αὐτόν τί ποιήσωμεν
verses.transliteration: de kai telōnai Ēlthon baptisthēnai Didaskale kai eipan pros auton ti poiēsōmen
verses.literal: - Even tax collectors came to be baptized Teacher - they asked - - what should we do

verses.original: πράσσετε Μηδὲν πλέον παρὰ τὸ ὑμῖν διατεταγμένον δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: prassete Mēden pleon para to hymin diatetagmenon de Ho eipen pros autous
verses.literal: Collect no more than . . . - you are authorized - - he answered - -

verses.original: δὲ καὶ στρατευόμενοι Ἐπηρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες καὶ Τί ἡμεῖς ποιήσωμεν διασείσητε Μηδένα μηδὲ συκοφαντήσητε Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἀρκεῖσθε ὑμῶν τοῖς ὀψωνίοις
verses.transliteration: de kai strateuomenoi Epērōtōn auton legontes kai Ti hēmeis poiēsōmen diaseisēte Mēdena mēde sykophantēsēte Kai eipen autois kai arkeisthe hymōn tois opsōniois
verses.literal: Then . . . [some] soldiers asked him - And what vvv should we do Do not take money by force . . . or false accusation - he said . . . - Be content with your - wages

verses.original: δὲ τοῦ λαοῦ Προσδοκῶντος καὶ πάντων διαλογιζομένων ἐν αὐτῶν ταῖς καρδίαις περὶ τοῦ μή‿ ποτε Ἰωάννου αὐτὸς εἴη ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: de tou laou Prosdokōntos kai pantōn dialogizomenōn en autōn tais kardiais peri tou mē pote Iōannou autos eiē ho Christos
verses.literal: - The people were waiting expectantly and {were} all wondering in their - hearts - - if . . . John - could be the Christ

verses.original: ὁ Ἰωάννης ἀπεκρίνατο πᾶσιν λέγων Ἐγὼ μὲν βαπτίζω ὑμᾶς ὕδατι δὲ ὁ ἰσχυρότερός μου ἔρχεται τὸν ἱμάντα τῶν οὗ αὐτοῦ ὑποδημάτων εἰμὶ οὐκ ἱκανὸς λῦσαι αὐτὸς βαπτίσει ὑμᾶς ἐν Ἁγίῳ Πνεύματι καὶ πυρί
verses.transliteration: ho Iōannēs apekrinato pasin legōn Egō men baptizō hymas hydati de ho ischyroteros mou erchetai ton himanta tōn hou autou hypodēmatōn eimi ouk hikanos lysai autos baptisei hymas en Hagiō Pneumati kai pyri
verses.literal: - John answered all of them - I - baptize you with water but [One] more powerful than I will come the straps of whose . . . sandals I am not worthy to untie He will baptize you with [the] Holy Spirit and with fire

verses.original: οὗ τὸ πτύον ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ χειρὶ διακαθᾶραι αὐτοῦ τὴν ἅλωνα καὶ συναγαγεῖν τὸν σῖτον εἰς αὐτοῦ τὴν ἀποθήκην δὲ κατακαύσει τὸ ἄχυρον ἀσβέστῳ πυρὶ
verses.transliteration: hou to ptyon en autou tē cheiri diakatharai autou tēn halōna kai synagagein ton siton eis autou tēn apothēkēn de katakausei to achyron asbestō pyri
verses.literal: [His] - winnowing fork [is] in His - hand to clear His - threshing floor and to gather the wheat into His - barn but He will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire

verses.original: οὖν μὲν Πολλὰ καὶ ἕτερα παρακαλῶν εὐηγγελίζετο τὸν λαόν
verses.transliteration: oun men Polla kai hetera parakalōn euēngelizeto ton laon
verses.literal: vvv [With these and] many - other exhortations [John] proclaimed the good news to the people

verses.original: δὲ ἐλεγχόμενος ὑπ’ αὐτοῦ ὁ Ἡρῴδης ὁ τετραάρχης περὶ τοῦ αὐτοῦ ἀδελφοῦ τῆς γυναικὸς Ἡρῳδιάδος καὶ περὶ πάντων πονηρῶν ὧν ὁ Ἡρῴδης ἐποίησεν
verses.transliteration: de elenchomenos hyp’ autou ho Hērōdēs ho tetraarchēs peri tou autou adelphou tēs gynaikos Hērōdiados kai peri pantōn ponērōn hōn ho Hērōdēs epoiēsen
verses.literal: But when he rebuked . . . . . . - Herod the tetrarch regarding - his brother’s - wife Herodias and - all [the] evils - - [he] had done

verses.original: προσέθηκεν τοῦτο καὶ ἐπὶ πᾶσιν καὶ κατέκλεισεν τὸν Ἰωάννην ἐν φυλακῇ
verses.transliteration: prosethēken touto kai epi pasin kai katekleisen ton Iōannēn en phylakē
verses.literal: [Herod] added this - to them all - He locked - John {up} in prison

verses.original: δὲ Ἐγένετο ἐν ἅπαντα τὸν λαὸν τῷ βαπτισθῆναι Ἰησοῦ βαπτισθέντος καὶ καὶ προσευχομένου τὸν οὐρανὸν ἀνεῳχθῆναι
verses.transliteration: de Egeneto en hapanta ton laon tō baptisthēnai Iēsou baptisthentos kai kai proseuchomenou ton ouranon aneōchthēnai
verses.literal: When . . . . . . all the people - were being baptized Jesus was baptized too And as He was praying - heaven was opened

verses.original: καὶ τὸ τὸ Ἅγιον Πνεῦμα καταβῆναι ἐπ’ αὐτόν σωματικῷ εἴδει ὡς περιστερὰν καὶ φωνὴν γενέσθαι ἐξ οὐρανοῦ Σὺ εἶ μου ὁ ἀγαπητός ὁ Υἱός ἐν σοὶ εὐδόκησα
verses.transliteration: kai to to Hagion Pneuma katabēnai ep’ auton sōmatikō eidei hōs peristeran kai phōnēn genesthai ex ouranou Sy ei mou ho agapētos ho Huios en soi eudokēsa
verses.literal: and the - Holy Spirit descended on Him in a bodily form like a dove And a voice came from heaven You are My - beloved - Son in You I am well pleased

verses.original: Καὶ Ἰησοῦς αὐτὸς ἦν ὡσεὶ τριάκοντα ἐτῶν ἀρχόμενος Ὢν ἐνομίζετο ὡς υἱός Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Ἠλὶ
verses.transliteration: Kai Iēsous autos ēn hōsei triakonta etōn archomenos Ōn enomizeto hōs huios Iōsēph tou Ēli
verses.literal: - Jesus Himself was about thirty years [old] when He began [His ministry] He was regarded as [the] son of Joseph the [son] of Heli

verses.original: τοῦ Μαθθὰτ τοῦ Λευὶ τοῦ Μελχὶ τοῦ Ἰανναὶ τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ
verses.transliteration: tou Maththat tou Leui tou Melchi tou Iannai tou Iōsēph
verses.literal: the [son] of Matthat the [son] of Levi the [son] of Melchi the [son] of Jannai the [son] of Joseph

verses.original: τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Ἀμὼς τοῦ Ναοὺμ τοῦ Ἑσλὶ τοῦ Ναγγαὶ
verses.transliteration: tou Mattathiou tou Amōs tou Naoum tou Hesli tou Nangai
verses.literal: the [son] of Mattathias the [son] of Amos the [son] of Nahum the [son] of Esli the [son] of Naggai

verses.original: τοῦ Μαὰθ τοῦ Ματταθίου τοῦ Σεμεῒν τοῦ Ἰωσὴχ τοῦ Ἰωδὰ
verses.transliteration: tou Maath tou Mattathiou tou Semein tou Iōsēch tou Iōda
verses.literal: the [son] of Maath the [son] of Mattathias the [son] of Semein the [son] of Josech the [son] of Joda

verses.original: τοῦ Ἰωανὰν τοῦ Ῥησὰ τοῦ Ζοροβάβελ τοῦ Σαλαθιὴλ τοῦ Νηρὶ
verses.transliteration: tou Iōanan tou Rhēsa tou Zorobabel tou Salathiēl tou Nēri
verses.literal: the [son] of Joanan the [son] of Rhesa the [son] of Zerubbabel the [son] of Shealtiel the [son] of Neri

verses.original: τοῦ Μελχὶ τοῦ Ἀδδὶ τοῦ Κωσὰμ τοῦ Ἐλμαδὰμ τοῦ Ἢρ
verses.transliteration: tou Melchi tou Addi tou Kōsam tou Elmadam tou Ēr
verses.literal: the [son] of Melchi the [son] of Addi the [son] of Cosam the [son] of Elmadam the [son] of Er

verses.original: τοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Ἐλιέζερ τοῦ Ἰωρὶμ τοῦ Μαθθὰτ τοῦ Λευὶ
verses.transliteration: tou Iēsou tou Eliezer tou Iōrim tou Maththat tou Leui
verses.literal: the [son] of Joshua the [son] of Eliezer the [son] of Jorim the [son] of Matthat the [son] of Levi

verses.original: τοῦ Συμεὼν τοῦ Ἰούδα τοῦ Ἰωσὴφ τοῦ Ἰωνὰμ τοῦ Ἐλιακὶμ
verses.transliteration: tou Symeōn tou Iouda tou Iōsēph tou Iōnam tou Eliakim
verses.literal: the [son] of Simeon the [son] of Judah the [son] of Joseph the [son] of Jonam the [son] of Eliakim

verses.original: τοῦ Μελεὰ τοῦ Μεννὰ τοῦ Ματταθὰ τοῦ Ναθὰμ τοῦ Δαυὶδ
verses.transliteration: tou Melea tou Menna tou Mattatha tou Natham tou Dauid
verses.literal: the [son] of Melea the [son] of Menna the [son] of Mattatha the [son] of Nathan the [son] of David

verses.original: τοῦ Ἰεσσαὶ τοῦ Ἰωβὴδ τοῦ Βοὸς τοῦ Σαλὰ τοῦ Ναασσὼν
verses.transliteration: tou Iessai tou Iōbēd tou Boos tou Sala tou Naassōn
verses.literal: the [son] of Jesse the [son] of Obed the [son] of Boaz the [son] of Sala the [son] of Nahshon

verses.original: τοῦ Ἀμιναδὰβ τοῦ Ἀδμὶν τοῦ Ἀρνὶ τοῦ Ἑσρὼμ τοῦ Φαρὲς τοῦ Ἰούδα
verses.transliteration: tou Aminadab tou Admin tou Arni tou Hesrōm tou Phares tou Iouda
verses.literal: the [son] of Amminadab the [son] of Admin the [son] of Arni the [son] of Hezron the [son] of Perez the [son] of Judah

verses.original: τοῦ Ἰακὼβ τοῦ Ἰσαὰκ τοῦ Ἀβραὰμ τοῦ Θάρα τοῦ Ναχὼρ
verses.transliteration: tou Iakōb tou Isaak tou Abraam tou Thara tou Nachōr
verses.literal: the [son] of Jacob the [son] of Isaac the [son] of Abraham the [son] of Terah the [son] of Nahor

verses.original: τοῦ Σεροὺχ τοῦ Ῥαγαῦ τοῦ Φάλεκ τοῦ Ἔβερ τοῦ Σαλὰ
verses.transliteration: tou Serouch tou Rhagau tou Phalek tou Eber tou Sala
verses.literal: the [son] of Serug the [son] of Reu the [son] of Peleg the [son] of Eber the [son] of Shelah

verses.original: τοῦ Καϊνὰμ τοῦ Ἀρφαξὰδ τοῦ Σὴμ τοῦ Νῶε τοῦ Λάμεχ
verses.transliteration: tou Kainam tou Arphaxad tou Sēm tou Nōe tou Lamech
verses.literal: the [son] of Cainan the [son] of Arphaxad the [son] of Shem the [son] of Noah the [son] of Lamech

verses.original: τοῦ Μαθουσαλὰ τοῦ Ἑνὼχ τοῦ Ἰάρετ τοῦ Μαλελεὴλ τοῦ Καϊνὰμ
verses.transliteration: tou Mathousala tou Henōch tou Iaret tou Maleleēl tou Kainam
verses.literal: the [son] of Methuselah the [son] of Enoch the [son] of Jared the [son] of Mahalalel the [son] of Cainan

verses.original: τοῦ Ἐνὼς τοῦ Σὴθ τοῦ Ἀδὰμ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: tou Enōs tou Sēth tou Adam tou Theou
verses.literal: the [son] of Enosh the [son] of Seth the [son] of Adam the [son] of God
